description: This file contains shell functions for testing and verifying the consistency and correctness of multi-pack indexes (midx) in a Git repository. It includes functions to check midx integrity, compute checksums, compare modes, and run a series of Git commands under different configurations.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of the midx files in the given directory by listing index files, reading midx data, comparing expected and actual index files, and verifying the multi-pack-index via Git.

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates and outputs the checksum of the midx file using the test-tool.

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Runs Git commands in two different core.multiPackIndex modes (false and true), compares their outputs, optionally sorts them, and verifies that outputs are consistent.

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs multiple Git commands in different modes using midx_git_two_modes to ensure consistency and correctness, encapsulated in a success expectation.
